plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a psychologist and interviewer, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that the writer Terence McKenna had an idea known as the stone ape theory. According to this idea, human consciousness first developed when our ape-like ancestors found and ate mushrooms that cause visions. If true, the human mind would owe its start to a plant-like drug.
